title: Pocketwire Personal Account Plan Fee Schedule
content:
The subscription figures of each Pocketwire Personal Account plan are fixed per plan as follows. Amounts are in USD; periods are calendar days.

| Plan | Monthly plan fee | Annual plan fee | Annual billing available | Free-trial days on a first subscription | Annual-fee refund window (days) | Restricted-fee waiver period (days) | A downgrade from this plan takes effect |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | 0 | 0 | 10 | Immediately |
| Pocketwire Core | 0.00 | 0.00 | No | 0 | 0 | 10 | Immediately |
| Pocketwire Plus | 4.99 | 47.90 | Yes | 30 | 14 | 10 | At the end of the billing period |
| Pocketwire Prime | 9.99 | 95.90 | Yes | 30 | 14 | 10 | At the end of the billing period |
| Pocketwire Onyx | 16.99 | 163.10 | Yes | 14 | 14 | 7 | At the end of the billing period |
| Pocketwire Summit | 49.99 | 479.90 | Yes | 0 | 30 | 5 | At the end of the billing period |

### What each column states

- **Monthly plan fee** — the subscription fee for the plan when it is billed monthly, charged on each plan renewal date.
- **Annual plan fee** — the subscription fee for the plan when it is billed annually, charged once on the annual plan renewal date.
- **Annual billing available** — whether the plan can be billed annually instead of monthly.
- **Free-trial days** — the length of the free trial on a first subscription to the plan, in calendar days counted from the plan change date; 0 means the plan has no trial.
- **Annual-fee refund window** — the calendar days after an annual plan fee is charged during which cancelling or downgrading refunds that annual fee in full; 0 means there is no refund window.
- **Restricted-fee waiver period** — the number of calendar days of limitation or security lock on which the waiver of a monthly plan fee turns.
- **Downgrade timing** — when a downgrade from the plan to a lower plan takes effect: immediately, or at the end of the billing period.

### Reading the schedule

- Pocketwire Lite and Pocketwire Core carry a monthly and an annual plan fee of 0.00 and cannot be billed annually.
- Among the paid plans, Pocketwire Plus and Pocketwire Prime offer a 30-day trial, Pocketwire Onyx a 14-day trial, and Pocketwire Summit none.
- The annual-fee refund window is 14 days on Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime and Pocketwire Onyx, and 30 days on Pocketwire Summit.
- The restricted-fee waiver period shortens as the plan rises: 10 days up to Pocketwire Prime, 7 days on Pocketwire Onyx and 5 days on Pocketwire Summit.
